prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Redesign the CraftDeja brand logo to match the selected promotional artwork. Image 1 is the selected marketing artwork, a style reference only: match its warm sculpted gold/brass, near-black forged metal, thin cyan/violet edge illumination and emerald energy. Image 2 is the canonical mascot identity reference: preserve recognizable bright green goblin face, large pointed ears, swept black hair, brass engineer goggles with emerald lenses, cheeky confident friendly grin. Make a fresh original logo asset, not a poster, not a screenshot, no background scenery. This brand represents economical profession leveling and crafting guidance for World of Warcraft: Forever. Premium polished hand-painted fantasy game branding, strong iconic silhouette, precise contours, clean generous transparent padding. True transparent background (alpha); no black rectangle, no checkerboard painted into output, no white background, no cast shadow or haze outside the logo. Gold and green dominate, cyan and violet are thin controlled accent edges; solid dark internal surfaces retain readability on light or dark webpages. No official Blizzard/WoW/CurseForge logos, no extra marketing text, no slogan, no version number, no stars, no badges, no watermark. Original Goblin personality should be mischievous and clever, not evil or monstrous. Make polished legible production-ready high-resolution PNG artwork.
Deliverable: main logo lockup. Landscape approximately 3:2, compact centered full emblem. A goblin head and partial shoulders emerge above a horizontally elongated brass-and-forged-metal nameplate; ears project outward and overlap its upper corners. The mascot is subordinate enough that the exact wordmark 'CraftDeja' stays very large, dominant, and readable. Render the word CraftDeja once, exactly capitalized C and D, in bold sculpted gold fantasy serif lettering like image 1's logo, open counters and strong separation from the dark inner plate. A small emerald gem centered in the lower frame and two tiny abstract workshop fasteners are enough decoration. Avoid excessive filigree or tiny wires. Head, ears, hair and nameplate all fully inside frame. One unified recognizable mark, no duplicate icon, no mockup sheet. Retain transparent surrounding area.
